verdict.rationale: An IP office could plausibly publish versioned public APIs, as other patent and trademark offices do, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web portals for e-filing, public search and status tracking. Nothing documents an API, versioning or a deprecation policy, and the llms.txt probe returned a 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
